field.label: Enable PPPoE Server
field.help: Enable the PPPoE Access Concentrator service. Configuration changes restart the daemon and drop active sessions (mpd5 cannot reload).

field.label: Authentication method
field.help: Authentication protocol offered to clients.

field.label: Default service name
field.help: Default PPPoE service name. Empty accepts any service name requested by the client.

field.label: MTU
field.help: Default MTU for PPP links (1492 for standard PPPoE).

field.label: MRU
field.help: Default MRU for PPP links.

field.label: Enable IPv6 (IPv6CP)
field.help: Negotiate IPv6CP so sessions get an IPv6 link-local address. Hand out a global prefix with Router Advertisements (Services → Router Advertisements) on the PPPoE interface group for SLAAC.

field.label: DNS server 1
field.help: Primary DNS server handed to clients via IPCP.

field.label: DNS server 2
field.help: Secondary DNS server handed to clients via IPCP.

field.label: Maximum sessions
field.help: Global cap on concurrent PPPoE sessions.

field.label: Sessions per username
field.help: Maximum simultaneous logins per username.

field.label: CARP failover interlock
field.help: Run the PPPoE server only while this node is CARP MASTER: the service stops on transition to BACKUP and starts on transition to MASTER. PPPoE sessions are not synchronized between nodes — clients reconnect after a failover.

field.label: RADIUS authentication
field.help: Authenticate PPPoE clients against the configured RADIUS servers instead of only the local user database.

field.label: RADIUS accounting
field.help: Send Accounting-Start/Interim/Stop records to the configured RADIUS servers.

field.label: Interim accounting interval (s)
field.help: Interval for Accounting Interim-Update records; 0 disables interim updates.

field.label: RADIUS timeout (s)
field.help: Timeout per RADIUS request.

field.label: RADIUS retries
field.help: Retries per RADIUS server before trying the next one.

field.label: RADIUS source address
field.help: Source IPv4 address for RADIUS requests on multihomed systems.

field.label: NAS-IP-Address
field.help: Value for the NAS-IP-Address attribute. Empty uses the system default.

field.label: NAS-Identifier
field.help: Value for the NAS-Identifier attribute. Empty uses the local hostname.

field.label: Message-Authenticator
field.help: Add the Message-Authenticator attribute to Access-Requests (recommended).

field.label: Local user shaping (ext-auth)
field.help: Authenticate local users through an external-auth backend instead of the secrets file, so per-user upload/download limits (set on each Local User) are applied via mpd5 rate limiters. Leave off if you do not shape local users; RADIUS shaping works independently.

field.label: RADIUS CoA / Disconnect
field.help: Enable the RFC 5176 listener so a RADIUS server or billing system can disconnect active subscribers. Requires a shared secret and an allowed-client list below.

field.label: CoA port
field.help: UDP port for Disconnect/CoA requests (default 3799).

field.label: CoA shared secret
field.help: Shared secret used to authenticate Disconnect requests.

field.label: CoA allowed clients
field.help: Comma-separated list of source IPv4/IPv6 addresses or CIDRs allowed to send Disconnect requests. Requests from any other source are dropped.

field.label: Log level
field.help: Daemon log verbosity (debug enables per-protocol tracing).
